newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra in systems deal with Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Telstra in systems deal with Argentina.

text.p: State-owned Telstra Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it has licensed its billing system, Flexcab, to Telecom Argentina.

"This is the first international deal, but there are others in the pipeline, including agreements with major USA-based telecommunications companies which we will announce shortly," Telstra executive Dwight King said in a statement.
Telstra said the licence to Telecom Argentina was part of an agreement with Andersen Consulting, in the first of global deals with the potential to earn Australia A$75 million in export earnings.
Andersen is responsible for licensing Telstra's FLEXCAB intellectual property to international companies to maximise a return on Telstra's billing system development.
